description: Structured capture of customer needs, pain points, and desired product attributes gathered through field interviews, dealer feedback, and market research.
Formal document defining the product's target segment, competitive positioning, key performance targets, regulatory requirements, and market timing constraints.
Systematic comparison of competing products across key technical, commercial, and customer experience parameters.
Engineering assessment of whether the proposed product concept can be realised within the target cost, weight, performance, and regulatory constraints.
Financial and strategic justification for the program investment including market sizing, revenue projections, IRR, NPV, and payback period.
Formally agreed product cost target broken down by system and sub-system, signed off by Engineering, Finance, and Program Management.
Comprehensive review of applicable emissions, safety, and homologation regulations for all target geographies.
Document confirming alignment of the proposed program with the organisation's platform and product portfolio strategy.
Foundational document defining scope, objectives, key milestones, budget envelope, team structure, and success criteria.
Top-down bill of materials estimate covering major assemblies and systems to validate target cost feasibility.
Structured identification and evaluation of program risks across technical, commercial, supply chain, and regulatory dimensions.
Matrix documenting all required sign-offs for the Pre-KO gate listing each stakeholder, their role, and their recorded decision.
Quality Assurance and Customer Complaint inputs summarising known field issues and warranty data from current-generation products.
Formally baselined product requirement specification covering all functional, performance, safety, and quality requirements.
First formal design review covering concept-level design decisions, key engineering trade-offs, and unresolved open points.
Initial Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis identifying potential failure modes for all major systems and sub-systems.
Design Verification Plan matrix specifying all tests and analyses required to validate each product requirement.
Report confirming the selected concept meets all product requirements defined in the PRF.
Formal sign-off on the approved exterior and interior styling theme including Class-A surface freeze and colour selection.
Complete set of approved concept sketches and renders covering exterior, interior, and key design details.
Frozen vehicle package layout defining overall dimensions, hard-point locations, occupant package, and powertrain installation.
Document confirming the selected powertrain configuration including engine, transmission, driveline, and NVH strategy.
Comprehensive sourcing strategy identifying nominated suppliers for all key systems and components.
Detailed cost target decomposition by system and sub-system providing engineering and sourcing teams with specific cost envelopes.
Structured review of the concept design against manufacturing process capabilities, tooling feasibility, and assembly sequence constraints.
Human factors and ergonomics evaluation of occupant package, controls layout, ingress/egress, visibility, and physical load during operation.
Total cost of ownership model covering acquisition cost, fuel, maintenance, service intervals, and residual value over the product lifecycle.
Comprehensive plan for achieving regulatory type approval in all target markets covering applicable standards, test programmes, and certification timelines.
Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis documenting potential failure modes in manufacturing and assembly processes before tooling investment.
Finalised and approved Design Verification Plan detailing all test activities required to sign off each product requirement prior to prototype build.
Consolidated report summarising results from all virtual simulation and analysis activities confirming the digital model meets performance targets.
Formal sign-off confirming completion and acceptance of all Computer Aided Engineering analyses including solver settings and mesh quality assessments.
FEA-based structural analysis covering static stiffness, bending and torsion modes, load case stress results, and safety factor compliance.
Virtual durability analysis using road load data inputs and fatigue life prediction models to confirm structural and chassis component design life targets.
CFD and thermal simulation report confirming powertrain cooling, cabin HVAC performance, and heat soak behaviour under extreme ambient conditions.
Noise, Vibration, and Harshness simulation covering modal analysis, acoustic sensitivity, and predicted interior sound levels against customer perception targets.
Predictive emission compliance model validating the proposed powertrain calibration strategy will meet regulatory limits under applicable test cycles.
Formal review of the full-vehicle digital assembly model checking component interferences, service access, wiring harness routing, and packaging compliance.
Statistical and worst-case tolerance analysis for critical assembly interfaces confirming manufacturing tolerances will deliver acceptable fit and function.
Architecture review of embedded software and ECU network topology covering ISO 26262 compliance, AUTOSAR implementation, and cybersecurity requirements.
Formally approved electrical architecture and schematic package covering all vehicle circuits, CAN topology, connector definitions, and wire harness layout.
Release of Level 2 engineering drawings and 3D data for all parts required for prototype build, issued to suppliers with full GD&T and material specifications.
Confirmation that all nominated prototype suppliers have completed onboarding including quality system approval, NDA execution, and commercial agreements.
Signed confirmation that all Validation Prototype parts have been received, dimensional inspection completed, and parts cleared for assembly.
Comprehensive report documenting the Validation Prototype build process, recording all deviations from design intent and open points raised during assembly.
Formal sign-off confirming each prototype vehicle has been assembled to the approved build standard and cleared for test track and laboratory activities.
Report confirming formal kickoff of production tooling programmes for all stamping, casting, injection moulding, and forging tools.
Master test plan for all prototype vehicle testing activities covering DVP execution, regulatory pre-compliance tests, and mileage accumulation targets.
Production Part Approval Process submission package from nominated suppliers covering dimensional results, material certifications, and process capability studies.
Draft manufacturing process plan defining the sequence of operations, workstation content, cycle times, and tooling requirements for vehicle assembly.
Formal review confirming the production design can be manufactured within the plant's process capability, cycle time, and quality requirements.
Release of approved fixture and gauge designs for all body assembly, welding, and inspection operations.
Report confirming calibration of all powertrain, chassis, and control systems on prototype vehicles, documenting ECU software versions and calibration parameters.
Qualification test results for all new or modified components not previously validated in a Swaraj/Mahindra application.
Analysis of actual prototype-phase costs against approved cost targets, identifying variances at system and component level with proposed corrective actions.
Consolidated Validation Prototype test results covering all DVP activities completed on prototype vehicles with outcomes against acceptance criteria.
Confirmation that all homologation build vehicles have been assembled, signed off, and submitted to relevant certification agencies.
Assessment of supplier PPAP submission status for all production parts confirming all Level 3 PPAP requirements are met ahead of SOP.
Report on pre-production field trials conducted with nominated fleet operators documenting real-world performance and field issues under typical operating conditions.
Formal certificate confirming all production tools have passed trial run acceptance, dimensional capability studies, and surface quality approval.
Results from accelerated durability field tests on pre-production vehicles across structured road profiles confirming compliance with design life targets.
Reliability test results covering MTBF analysis, environmental stress screening, and accelerated life testing for electronic modules and safety-critical components.
Type approval emission test results from accredited laboratories confirming compliance with applicable emission standards for all target markets.
Consolidated safety compliance evidence covering crashworthiness tests, operator safety systems, and regulatory safety standards compliance for all target markets.
Formal readiness review confirming production line, assembly fixtures, operator training, and material supply are prepared for the first line trial build event.
Statistical process capability analysis for all critical-to-quality characteristics confirming Cpk targets are achieved on production tools and processes before SOP.
Final signed production part approval confirming all supplier and in-house produced parts meet dimensional, material, and functional requirements from approved production tooling.
Pre-launch warranty risk assessment predicting failure rates, warranty cost exposure, and top warranty contributors based on DVP results and DFMEA risk ranking.
Engineering Release to Start of Volume Production sign-off confirming all engineering open points are closed and ECU software is production-released.
Report documenting the Pre-Production batch build outcomes including build quality observations, line rate achievement, and assembly deviations.
Formal gate review confirming production system including line, tooling, manpower, material supply, and quality controls is ready for full volume production.
Detailed report of line trial build results capturing build quality metrics, ergonomic observations, operator feedback, and process timing data.
Comprehensive pre-launch readiness checklist verifying completion of all commercial, technical, regulatory, service, and supply chain requirements for product launch.
Structured plan defining quality monitoring activities, review cadence, escalation thresholds, and reporting format for the first twelve months of production.
Plan for systematic collection and analysis of customer feedback and satisfaction data in the first year post-launch covering dealer surveys and digital feedback channels.
Plan for monitoring real-world product performance including telematics data analysis, field failure tracking, and periodic technical audits of in-service vehicles.
Documented plan capturing planned product and process improvements to be implemented in the production ramp-up phase, prioritised by customer impact and cost.
Post-launch cost reduction programme identifying value engineering opportunities, sourcing cost-downs, and manufacturing efficiency improvements with defined targets.
Report tracking actual production volume against the approved ramp-up curve documenting build quality performance, downtime events, and corrective actions.
Formal review of supply chain partner performance during launch phase covering delivery performance, quality reject rates, and capacity compliance.
Consolidated lessons learned document capturing key insights from the complete NPD program lifecycle covering technical, process, supplier, and commercial learnings.
